About us

A neighbourhood salon with a city finish

Velvet & Vine started as a two-chair studio in 2013. Today our team of nine stylists, colourists and therapists shares one rule: honest advice, even when it means talking you out of the expensive option.

  • Certified, senior teamEvery stylist has 5+ years on the floor and trains monthly on new techniques.
  • Clean-beauty productsAmmonia-free colour and cruelty-free care ranges, patch-tested as standard.
  • Book in under a minuteReal-time availability below — no phone tag, no waiting on hold.
